prompt.composition: Widescreen cinematic tableau above a sparkling seaway. Left: A colony of Pteranodons nesting on a high chalk pillar. Center: A massive Quetzalcoatlus standing tall on a beach, towering like a giraffe. Right: A trio of Nyctosaurus in a coordinated bank-turn. Background: A distant hazy horizon of the Interior Seaway. Foreground: Small, fluffy feathered birds (Hesperornis) bobbing in the water.
prompt.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC. Brilliant midday sun reflecting off white chalk cliffs and turquoise water, creating high-albedo ground reflection.
prompt.texture_standard: High-end 3D character groom. Satiny skin on wings, velvety 'pycnofibers' (fur-like fluff) on bodies, and polished, translucent colorful crests. Zero grit, zero scales.

color_palette.pteranodons: Teal bodies with vibrant 'sunset' orange and red crests.
color_palette.quetzalcoatlus: Royal purple skin with a pale cream underbelly and a bright yellow beak.
color_palette.nyctosaurus: Slate blue with striking white-and-black striped 'sail' crests.
color_palette.environment: Chalky white cliffs, turquoise water, and deep green palm-fringed shorelines.

prompt.environment: EPICONTINENTAL_SEAWAY habitat. High-visibility turquoise water with refractive ripples and pale, high-albedo chalky seafloors.
prompt.negative_prompt: photorealistic, ground dinosaurs, grainy, lumpy, grit, scary, horror, blood, open mouths, aggressive, 90s CGI, plastic toy, museum model, grey sky, muddy
